Plot a triangle pool

Source: R/wkpool_tri.R
plot.wkpool_tri.Rd

Draws every triangle with one call to graphics::polygon(), indexing the vertex pool directly (triangles separated by NA). This avoids building geometry: on 40,000 triangles it draws in a fraction of a second, where casting to wk polygons and plotting those takes over a minute.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'wkpool_tri'
plot(x, col = NULL, border = "black", add = FALSE, xlab = "x", ylab = "y", ...)

Arguments

x

A wkpool_tri.

col

Fill colour(s), recycled over triangles. If NULL (default), triangles are coloured by feature using the same palette as plot.wkpool().

border

Border colour(s) for triangle edges, NA for none.

add

If TRUE, draw on the current plot.

xlab, ylab

Axis labels when add = FALSE.

...

Further arguments passed to plot.default() when add = FALSE.

Value

Invisibly returns x.

Examples

x <- wk::as_wkb(c(
  "POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0), (0.2 0.3, 0.2 0.5, 0.4 0.5, 0.2 0.3))",
  "POLYGON ((1 0, 2 0, 2 1, 1 1, 1 0))"
))
if (requireNamespace("decido", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tri <- pool_triangulate(establish_topology(x))
  plot(tri)
  plot(tri, col = "grey", border = NA)
}
